request.description: Returns 200 while the API process is running. Does not check dependencies.

Returns 200 only when PostgreSQL is reachable and its schema is at the migration revision this build expects; otherwise 503. Redis is reported (required=false) but does not affect readiness: its features fail open. Load balancers should route traffic only to ready instances.
